hypothesis: The unchanged ETH compression-pullback route may provide materially higher portfolio cadence while retaining a small after-cost edge, but it requires a new source-compatible prospective window because chronological subgroup leadership rotated and the opened final block was largest-winner dependent.
why_reopened: Revision 6 rejected another static side or breakout-relation successor. A later exact long lifecycle, ETH:515428839206, added new evidence after that decision and changed the three-lifecycle live aggregate from negative without its largest winner to marginally positive without its largest winner. This justifies report-only requalification of the unchanged pooled mechanism; it does not reopen the rejected static subgroup split or authorize live execution.
decision: Run the exact unchanged provider in an isolated report-only observer. Do not add ETH to v53, change its 60-bps stop or 12-hour hold, select a side/relation subgroup, or scale historical results. Require source-compatible prospective eligible signals and resolved long and short markout lifecycles before an approval-ready live proposal.

exact_live_evidence.interpretation: The live aggregate is positive and observed entry slippage closely matches the 2-bps model, but N=3 and one $0.194017 winner dominates $0.198733 total net. Profit factor is not stable evidence at this sample size.

minimum_evidence_to_update.diagnostic: At least one source-attributable eligible event on each configured side with complete decision, bar, book, and markout coverage.
minimum_evidence_to_update.approval_ready: A preregistered compatible forward window with resolved long and short lifecycles, exact fees/funding/slippage/latency, stop-path review, missed-opportunity accounting, and positive economics without the largest winner. Historical and live-source behavior must not show another side/relation rotation that invalidates the pooled identity.

risks: The entry rule and 60-bps/12-hour exit were selected after multiple historical trials.
The opened final 60-day partition was previously inspected and becomes negative after removing its largest winner.
Historical win rate is low and returns depend on infrequent large winners.
Development and opened-final side/relation leadership rotated completely.
Three live lifecycles are insufficient to distinguish edge from variance.
The observer records production-equivalent decisions but cannot establish executable fill economics until eligible events receive causal book and markout follow-up.
falsifier: Reject or redesign the candidate if exact prospective signals materially under-deliver historical cadence, either side is persistently negative after costs, results again depend on one winner, source/feature parity fails, stop or latency behavior exceeds the frozen contract, or a different independent route produces stronger compatible evidence first.
